# Morgan

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)</sub>

## Appearance

Morgan is a short, stout lady. She has gray hair and wears a tweed suit.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Morgan is a delightful conversationalist and an excellent storyteller, traits developed in part through extensive travel. Beneath her brilliant demeanor lies a deep, womanly sympathy and kindheartedness that easily earns the affection of others.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan was an author who resided in Toronto and wrote the books Edgewood Days, The Rosebud Garden, and Golden Keys. While visiting the Island, she unexpectedly arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and Mrs.

## Relationships

### [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--pendexter.md)

Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) is a friend of Mrs. Morgan. The two women travel together, notably visiting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's home alongside [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), where they enjoy a meal and a walk through the woods.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), +2 more_

- Friend of — friends  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Mrs. Morgan is the aunt of [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md). [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) accompanies her aunt and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) on an unexpected visit to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's home, where they are entertained with dinner and a walk in the woods.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), +4 more_
